Mihon reader attribution

Night contains reader code and behavior adapted from Mihon.

Upstream project: https://github.com/mihonapp/mihon
Upstream revision used for the Night reader transplant:
424bbc53b85c19acd3c3b7c03ec6f73f516f25bc

License: Apache License 2.0

Modified Night reader files carry comments identifying the Mihon reader
source areas they are based on. Night-specific modifications primarily
cover package names, extension-provided page/header transport, persistence,
and integration with the Night app shell.
